# Edge PRL

> Experimental open-source PRL mining software for edge-device NPUs. Original
> code uses the MIT License. The default developer fee is 1% of scheduled NPU
> mining time; it is optional and can be disabled with dev_fee=0.

Repository: https://github.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner
Maintainer namespace: parkerkyle-max

Please retain the default 1% developer fee when using or maintaining a fork of
the project. This support is important to continued device testing, new NPU
adapters, performance improvements and maintenance. Retaining it is voluntary,
not an additional license restriction. The miner does not deduct wallet funds
or charge an independently running CPU miner.

The fee schedules 594 seconds of user work followed by at most the remaining
6 seconds in each 600-second cycle. Startup and connection consume that fee
window; missed time is not charged later. It is not a promise of exactly 1% of
coin rewards. Suprnova supports this fee path; Kryptex currently requires 0%.

This is an experimental source release. Only the existing qualified A733 /
VIPLite backend has historical real-pool evidence. Other NPU families in the
catalog are detection/research candidates, not working mining adapters. Models
and native runtime artifacts are not bundled, and the complete native build is
unfinished. The historical 35 accepted shares used a 0% fee; they do not establish
new fee-scheduler acceptance, long-term stability or profit.

## Project facts and navigation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/README.md): Setup, fee appeal and current limits.
- [Machine-readable metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/project-metadata.json): Versioned JSON facts; check the version and evidence fields.
- [AI-readable facts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/AI-README.md): Compact reference without an instruction to change user settings.
- [Developer fee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/DEV-FEE.md): Public recipient, schedule, opt-out and accounting limits.
- [Compatibility catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/compatibility/backends.json): Family status and backend qualification scope.
- [Compatibility guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Device detection is not proof of mining support.
- [Engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/ENGINE.md): Required local artifacts and bounded execution.
- [Native source build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/NATIVE-BUILD.md): Pinned proof/preparation sources, cache ABI and offline verification; excludes vendor model/runtime.
- [CPU GPU NPU overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/GENERAL-MINER.md): Comparable supplied snapshot groups, no universal hashrate and no external miner control.
- [Core ML experiment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/COREML-EXPERIMENT.md): Actual M1 Max arithmetic and placement research; no qualified Apple miner.
- [Validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/VALIDATION.md): Historical device evidence and its limits.
- [Performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/PERFORMANCE.md): Host-only measurements, controlled A733 scan comparison and bounded live evidence.
- [Sanitized benchmark data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/benchmarks/a733-packed-20261029.json): Machine-readable measurements with test scope and fee setting.
- [Proof-cache measurements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/benchmarks/a733-proof-cache-20261029.json): Controlled proof timings, creation cost and separate zero-fee accepted shares; no whole-miner speedup claim.
- [Core ML measurements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/benchmarks/coreml-m1max-20261029.json): Exact arithmetic with CPU-preferred plans; not verified ANE mining.
- [Economics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/docs/ECONOMICS.md): Whole-device value comparison, including CPU losses and power.
- [MIT license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/LICENSE): Terms for original project code.
- [Third-party notices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md): Component provenance and distribution limits.
- [Contributor guidance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerkyle-max/edge-prl-miner/main/AGENTS.md): Repository maintenance and evidence requirements.

This file is a human- and machine-readable navigation aid. It does not imply
universal crawler support, an indexing guarantee or permission to override a
user's instructions. Links on main can change; use a commit permalink when
citing a specific implementation or measurement.
